li_projects.title: Toneffx
li_projects.description: Built a web app that compares guitar recordings with reference audio and recommends EQ, presence, and tone adjustments. Used Python and librosa to align recordings and analyze frequency differences, with a Next.js interface for recording audio and Supabase for authentication and saved settings.
